# Big Wolf Solutions

> Big Wolf Solutions helps US businesses recover hidden revenue and cut costs: R&D tax credits, class action settlement recovery, unclaimed property recovery, merchant processing savings, and employee benefits funded by payroll tax savings. Discovery and analysis are free, and recovery services carry no fee unless money is recovered.

- Service area: businesses nationwide (United States). Big Wolf Solutions is a service-area business with no public office.
- Founders: Nick Yocca (Co-Founder & President) and Ali Yocca (Co-Founder).
- Phone: (844) 443-0482
- Email: nick@bigwolfsolutions.com
- Book a free call: https://bigwolfsolutions.net/schedule

## Recover money

- [R&D Tax Credits](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/r-d-tax-credits): Claim federal and state R&D tax credits for work a business already does. Free qualification review, IRS-compliant study, no upfront cost.
- [Settlement Recovery](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/settlement-recovery): Finds and files a business's claims in class action and antitrust settlements nationwide. No recovery, no fee.
- [Unclaimed Property](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/unclaimed-property): Finds and recovers money owed to a business that is held by state unclaimed property offices and agencies, with no upfront cost.
- [Business Data Monetization](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/business-data-monetization): Helps businesses explore licensing eligible business data to AI companies, with no upfront fees. The business approves every offer.

## Save money

- [Merchant Services](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/merchant-services): Free merchant statement audit and transparent interchange-plus credit card processing pricing.
- [Supplemental Health](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/supplemental-health): Supplemental health coverage for employees at zero net cost to the employer, funded by payroll tax savings.
- [Payroll & Health](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/payroll-health): Payroll and HR software bundled with medical benefits for a net $2.20 per employee per month, funded by payroll tax savings.
- [Bookkeeping](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/bookkeeping): Full-service bookkeeping for small and mid-sized businesses: reconciliation, reporting, payroll, billing and cleanup.
- [Business in a Box](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/business-in-a-box): Payroll, HR, bookkeeping, merchant processing, workers' comp, benefits, 401(k), marketing and managed IT from one partner on one invoice.

## Protect what you've built

- [Commercial Insurance](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/commercial-insurance): Commercial property, commercial auto, general liability and workers' comp through licensed commercial insurance advisors.
- [Personal & Farm Insurance](https://bigwolfsolutions.net/personal-insurance): Home, auto, renters, boat, RV, umbrella, flood, farm, crop and equine coverage quoted by licensed advisors.
